mapper.select:
select #{bookdate,jdbcType=DATE} bookdate ,#{enddate,jdbcType=DATE} enddate ,pos.INVEST_VARIETY ,pos.trade_type ,pos.IS_UNDER_TRADE ,pos.ASSET_CODE ,pos.PROD_ID ,pos.chl_id chlid ,pos.CCY ,(case pos.ASSET_CODE when 'REMAININGCASH' then '01' else info.asset_type end) assettype ,(case pos.ASSET_CODE when 'REMAININGCASH' then '1001' else info.ASSET_TYPE2 end) assettype2 ,ifnull(ifnull(info.PRO_INDUSTRY,info.INDUSTRY1),info.INDUSTRY_SHARES) INDUSTRY1 /*所属行业*/ ,info.IN_ASSET_TYPE IN_ASSET_TYPE /*行业一级分类*/ ,sum(pos.accuamt) ASSETVALUE_A /*穿透前资产价值*/ ,sum((case pos.trade_type when '05' then pos.accuqty else null end)) ASSETVALUE_B /*穿透后资产价值*/ ,ifnull(ifnull(c.rating ,d.rating),ifnull(a.rating,b.rating)) rating/*债券评级*/ ,(case info.PRIVATE_FLAG when '01' then '01' else null end) MONIT_TYPE ,(case info.PPPFLAG when '01' then '01' else null end) PPPFLAG ,(case info.IS_GOVERN_FUND when '01' then '01' else null end) IS_GOVERN_FUND1 ,(case info.PRIVATEFUND_FLAG when '01' then '01' else null end) PRIVATEFUND_FLAG ,(case info.PRIVATEPRD_FLAG when '01' then '01' else null end) PRIVATEPRD_FLAG ,(case info.BONDTOSTOCK_FLAG when '01' then '01' else null end) BONDTOSTOCK_FLAG ,info.MANAGE_TYPE MANAGE_TYPE /*管理方式*/ from CHB_ASSET_POSITION pos left join CHB_ASSET_INFO info on pos.ASSET_CODE=info.ASSET_CODE and info.status !='D'
left join a on info.FINANCIE=a.ASSET_CODE left join b on info.FINANCIE=b.ASSET_CODE
left join a on pos.ASSET_CODE=a.ASSET_CODE left join b on pos.ASSET_CODE=b.ASSET_CODE
left join c on pos.ASSET_CODE=c.ASSET_CODE left join d on pos.ASSET_CODE=d.ASSET_CODE left join CHB_PRD_BASEINFO prd on prd.PROD_ID=pos.PROD_ID and prd.status !='D' where 1=1 and prd.PROFIT_TYPE='03' and pos.trade_type in ('01','02','05') /*直投交易,通道交易,资管计划交易*/ and pos.cDATE =#{enddate,jdbcType=DATE}
and pos.prodid in
null) OR pos.prodid in (
#{item}
group by #{bookdate,jdbcType=DATE},#{enddate,jdbcType=DATE}, pos.INVEST_VARIETY,pos.trade_type,pos.IS_UNDER_TRADE, pos.ASSET_CODE, pos.PROD_ID, pos.chl_id, pos.CCY, (case pos.ASSET_CODE when 'REMAININGCASH' then '01' else info.asset_type end), (case pos.ASSET_CODE when 'REMAININGCASH' then '1001' else info.ASSET_TYPE2 end), ifnull(ifnull(info.PRO_INDUSTRY,info.INDUSTRY1),info.INDUSTRY_SHARES),info.IN_ASSET_TYPE, null,ifnull(ifnull(c.rating ,d.rating),ifnull(a.rating,b.rating)), (case info.PRIVATE_FLAG when '01' then '01' else null end), (case info.PPPFLAG when '01' then '01' else null end), (case info.IS_GOVERN_FUND when '01' then '01' else null end), (case info.PRIVATEFUND_FLAG when '01' then '01' else null end), (case info.PRIVATEPRD_FLAG when '01' then '01' else null end), (case info.BONDTOSTOCK_FLAG when '01' then '01' else null end), info.MANAGE_TYPE

select sum(POSITION.ASSETVALUE_A) ASSETVALUE_A, sum(POSITION.ASSETVALUE_B) ASSETVALUE_B, POSITION.ASSETTYPE, ifnull(POSITION.INDUSTRY1,'NULL') INDUSTRY1, POSITION.IN_ASSET_TYPE, POSITION.PPPFLAG, POSITION.MONIT_TYPE, POSITION.MANAGE_TYPE, POSITION.IS_GOVERN_FUND1, POSITION.PRIVATEFUND_FLAG, POSITION.PRIVATEPRD_FLAG, POSITION.BONDTOSTOCK_FLAG, POSITION.RATING,POSITION.ASSETTYPE2,ASSETINFO.ASSET_TYPE3, ASSETINFO.BANK_SEC_CAPITAL, ASSETINFO.BANK_SEC_PERPETUAL, ASSETINFO.BANK_SEC_PREFER from CHB_MONTH_ASSET_POSITION POSITION LEFT JOIN CHB_ASSET_INFO ASSETINFO ON ASSETINFO.ASSET_CODE = POSITION.ASSET_CODE and ASSETINFO.status in('E','M') where DATE_FORMAT(POSITION.ENDDATE, '%Y-%m-%d') >= #{startDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and DATE_FORMAT(POSITION.ENDDATE, '%Y-%m-%d') <= #{endDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR} group by POSITION.ASSETTYPE, ifnull(POSITION.INDUSTRY1,'NULL'), POSITION.IN_ASSET_TYPE, POSITION.PPPFLAG, POSITION.MONIT_TYPE, POSITION.MANAGE_TYPE, POSITION.IS_GOVERN_FUND1, POSITION.PRIVATEFUND_FLAG, POSITION.PRIVATEPRD_FLAG, POSITION.BONDTOSTOCK_FLAG, POSITION.RATING, POSITION.ASSETTYPE2,ASSETINFO.ASSET_TYPE3, ASSETINFO.BANK_SEC_CAPITAL, ASSETINFO.BANK_SEC_PERPETUAL, ASSETINFO.BANK_SEC_PREFER

SELECT SUM(cashflow) cashamt,CCY ccy,PROD_ID prodId FROM (SELECT SUM( CASE prdeal.TRADE_TYPE WHEN '03' THEN (ifnull(prdeal.TRADE_PRINCE, 0)+ifnull(prdeal.REDEMPTION_FEE,0)) * -1 WHEN '04' THEN 0 WHEN '05' THEN 0 WHEN '14' THEN 0 WHEN '15' THEN 0 WHEN '16' THEN ifnull(prdeal.TRADE_PRINCE, 0) * -1 WHEN '17' THEN (ifnull(prdeal.TRADE_PRINCE, 0)+ifnull(prdeal.REDEMPTION_FEE,0)) * -1 ELSE ifnull(prdeal.TRADE_PRINCE, 0) END) cashflow, prdeal.CCY,prdeal.PROD_ID FROM chb_prd_deal prdeal left join CHB_PRD_BASEINFO prd on prd.PROD_ID=prdeal.PROD_ID and prd.status !='D' WHERE PAY_DATE <=#{cdate,jdbcType=DATE} AND TRADE_TYPE NOT IN ('05','14','15') and prd.PROFIT_TYPE='03' AND PRDEAL.STATUS !='D' GROUP BY prdeal.CCY,prdeal.PROD_ID UNION ALL SELECT SUM( CASE prdeal.TRADE_TYPE WHEN '04' THEN ifnull(prdeal.INT_AMT, 0) * -1 ELSE 0 END) cashflow, prdeal.CCY,prdeal.PROD_ID FROM chb_prd_deal prdeal left join CHB_PRD_BASEINFO prd on prd.PROD_ID=prdeal.PROD_ID and prd.status !='D' WHERE INTEREST_DATE<=#{cdate,jdbcType=DATE} and prd.PROFIT_TYPE='03' AND PRDEAL.STATUS !='D' GROUP BY prdeal.CCY,prdeal.PROD_ID UNION ALL SELECT SUM(-1*ifnull(fee.AMT,0 ))cashflow, fee.CCY,fee.PROD_ID FROM chb_prd_fee_deal fee left join CHB_PRD_BASEINFO prd on prd.PROD_ID=fee.PROD_ID and prd.status !='D' WHERE fee.PAY_DATE <=#{cdate,jdbcType=DATE} and prd.PROFIT_TYPE='03' AND fee.STATUS !='D' GROUP BY fee.CCY,fee.PROD_ID ) base GROUP BY CCY,PROD_ID

SELECT sum( case when deal.CUR_ASSET_TYPE in ('01','03','05','08','10','12') then -1*ifnull(deal.AMT,0) else ifnull(deal.AMT,0) end ) cashamt ,DEAL.PROD_ID,DEAL.CCY FROM chb_invest_trade deal left join CHB_PRD_BASEINFO prd on prd.PROD_ID=deal.PROD_ID and prd.status !='D' where deal.CHL_CPCT_ID is null and prd.PROFIT_TYPE='03' and deal.DEALDATE <=#{cdate,jdbcType=DATE} and deal.STATUS !='D' group by DEAL.PROD_ID,DEAL.CCY

SELECT sum( case when deal.CUR_ASSET_TYPE in ('01','03','05','08','10','12') then -1*ifnull(deal.AMT,0) else ifnull(deal.AMT,0) end ) cashamt ,DEAL.PROD_ID,DEAL.CCY FROM chb_invest_trade deal left join CHB_PRD_BASEINFO prd on prd.PROD_ID=deal.PROD_ID and prd.status !='D' where deal.trade_type !='02' and prd.PROFIT_TYPE='03' and deal.DEALDATE <=#{cdate,jdbcType=DATE} and deal.STATUS !='D' group by DEAL.PROD_ID,DEAL.CCY

SELECT SUM(UNINVEST_CASH) CASHAMT FROM( select DISTINCT UNINVEST_CASH,PLAN_ASSET_ID from chb_bot_ast_pos where PLAN_ASSET_ID in (SELECT DISTINCT ASSET_CODE FROM chb_invest_trade deal left join CHB_PRD_BASEINFO prd on prd.PROD_ID=deal.PROD_ID and prd.status !='D' where deal.trade_type='05'and deal.status !='D' and prd.PROFIT_TYPE='03') and pos_date=#{cdate,jdbcType=DATE} and status !='D') de

select cp.PROD_ID prodId,Round((cp.accuqty/aq.qty)*ap.UNINVEST_CASH,2) cashamt, AP.PLAN_ASSET_ID oldAssetCode,ci.ccy from chb_asset_position cp INNER join ( select DISTINCT UNINVEST_CASH,PLAN_ASSET_ID from chb_bot_ast_pos where PLAN_ASSET_ID in (SELECT DISTINCT ASSET_CODE FROM chb_asset_position deal left join CHB_PRD_BASEINFO prd on prd.PROD_ID=deal.PROD_ID and prd.status !='D' where deal.trade_type='05' and prd.PROFIT_TYPE='03' and deal.CDATE=#{cdate,jdbcType=DATE}) and pos_date=#{cdate,jdbcType=DATE} and status !='D' and UNINVEST_CASH !=0) ap on ap.PLAN_ASSET_ID=cp.ASSET_CODE left join (select sum(cp.accuqty) qty,cp.ASSET_CODE from chb_asset_position cp INNER join ap on ap.PLAN_ASSET_ID=cp.ASSET_CODE where cp.CDATE=#{cdate,jdbcType=DATE} GROUP by cp.ASSET_CODE) aq on aq.ASSET_CODE=cp.ASSET_CODE left join chb_asset_info ci on ci.ASSET_CODE=AP.PLAN_ASSET_ID and ci.status !='D' where cp.CDATE=#{cdate,jdbcType=DATE}

WITH ap AS ( SELECT DISTINCT UNINVEST_CASH, PLAN_ASSET_ID,TOTAL_NUM FROM chb_bot_ast_pos WHERE (PLAN_ASSET_ID IN ( SELECT DISTINCT ASSET_CODE FROM chb_asset_position deal LEFT JOIN CHB_PRD_BASEINFO prd ON prd.PROD_ID = deal.PROD_ID AND prd.status != 'D' WHERE (deal.trade_type = '05' AND prd.PROFIT_TYPE = '03' AND deal.CDATE = #{cdate,jdbcType=DATE}) ) AND pos_date = #{cdate,jdbcType=DATE} AND status != 'D' AND UNINVEST_CASH != 0) ) SELECT cp.PROD_ID AS prodId , Round(cp.accuqty / ap.TOTAL_NUM * ap.UNINVEST_CASH, 2) AS cashamt , AP.PLAN_ASSET_ID AS oldAssetCode, ci.ccy,prd.IS_FHXGCP isFhxgcp FROM chb_asset_position cp INNER JOIN ap ON ap.PLAN_ASSET_ID = cp.ASSET_CODE LEFT JOIN chb_asset_info ci ON ci.ASSET_CODE = AP.PLAN_ASSET_ID AND ci.status != 'D' LEFT JOIN CHB_PRD_BASEINFO prd ON prd.PROD_ID = cp.PROD_ID WHERE cp.CDATE = #{cdate,jdbcType=DATE} AND prd.PROFIT_TYPE = '03'
and cp.prod_id in
null) OR cp.prod_id in (
#{prodid}

SELECT A.SUBJECT_NO AS assetCode, A.B_AMT AS assetvalueA, PRODINFO.PROD_ID AS prodId, PRODINFO.IS_FHXGCP AS isFhxgcp FROM BOK_BALANCE A LEFT JOIN CHB_PRD_BASEINFO PRODINFO ON PRODINFO.PROD_ID = A.BOOKSET_ID WHERE A.BALANCE_DATE = #{cdate,jdbcType=DATE} AND A.SUBJECT_NO IN (SELECT OBJFIELD1 FROM CHB_TYPE_MAPPING_EX WHERE MAPPINGCODE='MAPPINGCODE_FEE_SUBJECTNO' AND STATUS='E') AND A.BAL_FLAG = 'C'
and A.BOOKSET_ID in
null) OR A.BOOKSET_ID in (

AND PRODINFO.PROFIT_TYPE = '03'

SELECT ROUND( AA.SMV * (CC.ACCUAMT / BB.COST), 5 ) assetvalueB FROM RSK_VALTBL_ASSET_SUB AA LEFT JOIN ( SELECT IFNULL(SUM.SMV, 0) COST, SUM.PTL_ID FROM RSK_VALTBL_SUM_ASSET_SUB SUM WHERE SUM.VAL_DATE = #{enddate,jdbcType=DATE} AND SUM.SUB_CODE = 601 GROUP BY SUM.PTL_ID, SUM.SUB_CODE ) BB ON BB.PTL_ID = AA.PTL_ID LEFT JOIN CHB_ASSET_POSITION CC ON AA.PTL_ID = CC.ASSET_CODE WHERE AA.SUB_CODE = #{assetCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND CC.PROD_ID = #{prodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND AA.VAL_DATE = #{enddate,jdbcType=DATE}

SELECT position.PROD_ID, position.ASSETTYPE2, T.ASSETVALUE_B qcAssetValue, position.ASSETVALUE_B qmAssetValue, assinfo.FINANCIER_GRADE RATING , assinfo.GUA_TYPE, assinfo.TRADE_MARKET, info.IS_CONSTRACTE FROM CHB_MONTH_ASSET_POSITION position LEFT JOIN ( SELECT lastmonth.prod_id, lastmonth.asset_code, lastmonth.assetvalue_b FROM CHB_MONTH_ASSET_POSITION lastmonth WHERE ENDDATE = ADDDATE(str_to_date(#{cdate,jdbcType=DATE}, '%Y-%m-%d'),INTERVAL -1 MONTH) )T ON T.PROD_ID = position.PROD_ID and T.ASSET_CODE = position.ASSET_CODE LEFT JOIN CHB_ASSET_INFO ASSINFO ON position.ASSET_CODE = ASSINFO.ASSET_CODE AND ASSINFO.STATUS IN ('E','M') inner join CHB_PRD_BASEINFO info on info.PROD_ID = position.PROD_ID and info.STATUS in ('M', 'E') and info.PROFIT_TYPE = '03' where position.ENDDATE = #{cdate,jdbcType=DATE}

select prodInfo.PROD_ID as prodId,
case when prodInfo.OPERATE_MODE in ('01', '02') then prodInfo.MDATE
when ( select count(1) SCH_COUNT from CHB_PRD_OPENSCH where PROD_ID = #{prodId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} and STATUS in ('E', 'M') ) > 0 then
ifnull(( select min(OPEN_START) MIN_OPEN_START from CHB_PRD_OPENSCH where PROD_ID = #{prodId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} and STATUS in ('E', 'M') and OPEN_START > #{endDate, jdbcType=DATE} ), prodInfo.MDATE)
else null end as mdate from CHB_PRD_BASEINFO prodInfo where prodInfo.PROD_ID = #{prodId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} and prodInfo.STATUS in ('E', 'M')
